headline: Scanned 281 option-card bodies (contracted 283). Confirmed same-mechanism pairs on bodies: 0 (rename=0, paraphrase=0); fork-or-near=0 not collapsed.
question: Do any two of the 283 option cards describe the SAME mechanism under different ids and different wording - measured on card bodies, not on ids and titles?

calibration.lexical_coverage: Token-Jaccard fires on exact-body renames and high-overlap one-parameter forks. A paraphrase of the same mechanism sits at jaccard=0.384615 (below 0.5) so lexical-only coverage misses it. A full rewrite of the same mechanism sits at jaccard=0.055556 / embedding=0.0, the same DISTINCT band as a genuinely different card. Stemmed-content cosine is the second detector; it is not a neural embedding and does not claim full-rewrite recall.

residual_unknowns: 07-OPTION-UNIVERSE.md/.json with original card bodies is not mounted. Live bodies are canonical_mechanism texts from platform/corpus/CANONICAL-CLAIMS.json (option_universe representatives). The live same-mechanism count is over those present bodies only and is not extrapolated to 283.

Stemmed-content cosine is not a neural embedding. A full rewrite of the same mechanism remains in the DISTINCT band, matching the recorded finding that lexical Jaccard cannot see a full rewrite. CANONICAL-CLAIMS D3 uses a different (verb, locus, artifact) signature and is not this unit's detector.

reviewer.method: Re-ran only the embedding probe on the same planted mutants. Does not impersonate a Codex vendor identity.
